# S5 = R0.3 — switchcap per-device id/charge/cap dump along the live DN transient (V6.4.7, 2026-06-10)

**Status:** data sections auto-generated by `scripts/v6_4_7_s5_sc_dump.py`; verdicts hand-written below.
**Ground truth:** OSDI BSIM-CMG via PyCMG `eval_single_point` at identical absolute terminal bias (P0-D convention).

## Commands

```
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="" OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 \
  conda run -n pycircuitsim python scripts/v6_4_7_s5_sc_dump.py \
  > results/v6_4_7/s5_logs/s5_sc_dump.log 2>&1
```

Windows: SAMPLE 0.60–2.30 ns (phi high), EDGE 2.40–2.70 ns (phi fall 2.5→2.6 ns ±0.1), HOLD 2.60–4.30 ns (harness droop window). Conventions: off-diagonal caps compared in NN raw dQ/dV convention (OSDI cgd/cdg/cgs negated; FD-verified in the log). Clamp classes: REV (Rule-15 f_id=0), NEAR0 (|Vds|≤4.6·VT, >1 % attenuation), FREE.

## vsamp charge decomposition per window (fC) — C·ΔV = Q_res + Q_cap + Q_num (exact for Trap companion)

Q_res = resistive id into vsamp (TG devices); Q_cap = Δ(qg+qd) charge-VALUE pump via the source companion; Q_num = remainder = solver/NR-tolerance channel. `ΔQ_id = Q_res(NN) − Q_res(OSDI)` and `ΔQ_q = Q_cap(NN) − Q_cap(OSDI)` are the model-VALUE error injections along the same trajectory.

## Conclusion / ownership verdict

**The SC failure has three owners, none of them charge/cap VALUES, and the
dominant one is a harness semantics gap discovered by the trajectory-head
probe (`scripts/v6_4_7_s5_head_probe.py`):**

1. **DOMINANT — `.ic`/uic semantics gap (measurement, → S5b).** The NGSPICE
   side runs `tran ... uic` (integrate from `.ic v(vsamp)=0` exactly,
   `verify_complex_switchcap.py:88`); the DN side
   (`tests/common/complex.py:303-305`) uses `.ic` only as the *initial NR
   guess* of a full DC OP — which converges to the NN's off-state leakage
   equilibrium: vsamp(0) = **0.390 V (TSMC5, =Vin exactly)** / **0.704 V
   (TSMC16)** vs NGSPICE's 0.000 V. The TSMC5 gap (+9.52 fC) accrues
   *entirely* before any window (all four windows flat-zero — the cell sits
   at its artifact equilibrium from t=0); TSMC12/16 spend the whole sample
   window bleeding the artifact down toward Vin and don't finish.
2. **Rule-15 REV clamp blocks the recovery (P2).** Once vsamp > vin the TG
   must conduct in reverse; the clamp zeroes NN id there while OSDI carries
   real current. The withheld charge is REV-class-concentrated in the
   per-device tables: TSMC7 Mnt **+11.64 fC**, TSMC16 Mnt +7.66 / Mpt +3.44,
   TSMC12 Mnt +3.4–3.9 fC (SAMPLE window, n≈340 points each, NEAR0/FREE
   contributions 1–2 orders smaller).
3. **TSMC7 hold drift = NEAR0 id over-prediction (P3-adjacent).** The PMOS
   pass device leaks **−2.222 fC during HOLD ≡ 2.2 mV on 100 fF** — matching
   the measured 2.207 mV droop exactly; OSDI says 0.00 fC. Not caps, not
   numerics — the NN's near-zero-Vds normal-direction id is wrong where the
   1−exp attenuation should have it at sub-fA.

**Exonerated:** charge-pump VALUES (ΔQ_q ≤ 0.05 fC everywhere ≈ 0.5 % of the
gate gap), the full cap matrix at the trajectory biases (FD-verified
conventions, see tables), and solver numerics (Q_num ≈ 0.00 fC in every
window — the Trap companion telescopes exactly). **The S4 symcaps charge
"improvement" was therefore coincidental compensation** (a different C-stamp
redistributes the artifact OP's bleed-down), consistent with its catastrophic
30–137 mV hold side effect.

**Decision-table consequences:**
- SC is NOT id-frame-owned (P0, confirmed twice) and NOT charge-VALUE-owned
  ⇒ **drop SC from P5/P7 EV claims**.
- New step **S5b (measurement-fix class, E3-review required): make the DN
  transient honor `.ic` uic-style** — solve the OP with `.ic` nodes pinned
  (constrained solution, NOT force_ic's released re-solve) and start the
  transient from it. After S5b the sample window becomes *forward*
  conduction from vsamp=0 (no overshoot, no reverse recovery), so S5b alone
  may flip SC cells; the residual SC error is then forward-conduction id
  accuracy + the TSMC7 NEAR0 hold leak (P2/P3).
- `run_directnet_transient` is shared with ring_osc ⇒ S5b must re-run RO
  and blind-veto the three passing cells.
